additional_findings.finding: Ordinary computed source/measurement/feature nodes are not subject to actual-read or inherited causal-clock validation. A future source row known at 200 can be a value/provenance dependency of a feature row whose caller-declared input_known_at is 100. Neither validate_closure nor _admit traverses those external row clocks for the feature; the feature may be read at cut 100. This does not require a label or fitted ancestor, so repairing R03 label laundering and R04 prediction expiry alone does not close it.
additional_findings.repair: Require explicit retained row-level read/derivation evidence for computed measurement/feature nodes and reconcile every used external row against the original decision cut, inherited validity, actual completion and same-cut assembly. Externally supplied rows must remain explicitly external sources rather than unverified computed rows. Add a future-source -> ordinary-feature -> sanctioned input rejection and a legitimate same-cut derived positive case.

additional_findings.finding: validate_oof_producer checks that the requested sample exists in the population and has the declared date, but never that it belongs to the request fold evaluation_ids. A purged sample outside the evaluation block, excluded from every producer training set, can pass as an OOF sample by retaining the true group and a compatible earlier fit. Exact population/target/time checks proposed in R07 should explicitly include evaluation membership and evaluation boundaries.
additional_findings.repair: Require the requested row to be an actual evaluation member of the authoritative request fold, with its retained decision inside that fold interval; preserve independently declared cross-fold producer routes. Include a purged/outside-evaluation row negative case at the real OOF gate.

additional_findings.finding: The committed adapter performs float(_json(...)) without the existing finite scalar validator and checks only math.isfinite(result). Canonical JSON strings such as "Infinity" and booleans become floats; an infinite input to BinaryModel may yield sigmoid(infinity)=1 and pass the final finite check. Supplied FrequencyModel probabilities/cell counts/prior and BinaryModel scales are not domain-validated either, so finite out-of-range probabilities or zero-division can escape the intended typed admission. Matching immutable bytes is insufficient numerical validation.
additional_findings.repair: Before arithmetic, accept only the registered finite scalar representation, reject strings/bools/nonfinite values, validate positive scales and finite coefficients/intercepts, coherent frequency counts/prior/cuts and calibration floor, and validate output with the probability contract. Preserve existing arithmetic for valid supplied state. Add negative adapter cases without fitting a model.

additional_findings.finding: serve_bound_model unconditionally calls validate_oof_producer for every binding, including final-purpose requests. ReadRequest permits final requests without date_group/fold_node_id, so a legitimate final inference request necessarily fails the OOF fold check; a valid final model with prior training exposure also fails even when final inference target/time checks should govern. This is a distinct positive-path integration failure, not only the cross-session bypass in R09.
additional_findings.repair: Dispatch explicitly by coherent session purpose: OOF uses authoritative evaluation exclusion and routes; final uses its own admitted fitted-state completion, target, row, horizon and input checks. Reject audit/fit-label purposes for serving. Add positive final and OOF committed adapter cases for supported model classes, plus wrong target/clock negatives.

additional_findings.finding: Finite row/column/read/configuration size admission happens after semantic ID construction. validate_closure hashes every full node at line 484 before row/column bounds; arbitrary execution configuration bytes, row value bytes, namespace/slot strings or oversized nested read evidence can cause large recursive encoding before max_manifest_bytes is checked in commit. The configured payload bound only checks referenced blob sizes and does not bound these embedded semantic fields before hashing. ReadSession also has no standalone binding cardinality bound.
additional_findings.repair: Add lightweight exact type/count/embedded-byte-size validation before recursive canonicalization or hashing, and enforce a bounded session declaration/manifest size before per-binding resolution. Retain the registered ceilings rather than silently truncating. Add bounded over-limit sentinels that prove rejection occurs before encoding/IO.
